steps.title: 1. d4
steps.body: 1. d4 takes the centre with a pawn that the queen protects. It is solid, and it is hard for the opponent to attack.

steps.title: The Queen's Gambit
steps.body: White's pawn to c4 attacks the black pawn on d5. Black can accept or decline the pawn. Either way, White keeps the centre.

steps.title: Your move
steps.body: Black played 1... d5. Continue with c4, the Queen's Gambit.
steps.hint: Move the pawn on c2 two squares forward.
steps.success: Yes. The c4 pawn attacks the d5 pawn.
